response.description: Microsoft announces the opening of its fourth datacenter region in India, India South Central, with campuses in Hyderabad, Telangana. The region will provide customers with local, secure, state-of-the-art cloud infrastructure designed with AI readiness as a key focus. It supports growing demand for cloud and AI services, customer digital transformation, local data residency, improved latency, and resilient cloud capacity in India.
response.title: Generally Available: Microsoft Azure now available from new cloud region in India (India South Central)
